_doc: Twin-parity pixel ratchet (#1046 F3-F4, doc §6.3). Per-fixture HIGH-WATER DC (differing-pixel count) of the unified WebGL2 chain (?rhichain=1) vs the forced-WebGL2 twin at IDENTICAL cameras. SHRINK-ONLY per fixture: a value may only decrease; zero on EVERY fixture is F4's flip precondition; deleted with the twin in F6. null = NOT YET MEASURED — the orchestrator seeds the real value from the first ?rhichain=1 capture run (playground/e2e/_twin-parity-ratchet.spec.ts), which OWNS the live DC<=high-water assertion; the vitest gate (twin-parity-ratchet.test.ts) validates this file's shape + vacuity and SKIPS null entries. The fixtures set is the doc §3-F3 matrix and must stay in lockstep with the gate's CANONICAL_FIXTURES. SEEDED 2026-08-03 from the first post-flip captures (Inc-E2, chainFrame=true): the chain executes on WebGL2 but its VT content terminals are still native-bodied (VTR internals unwrap the pass — the remaining port), so these first high-waters measure content-less chain frames; they may ONLY shrink as the terminal port lands. Values = measured DC rounded UP past the SAME-CODE noise floor (two identical-code runs jittered by up to ~30 px on SwiftShader; the first exact-DC seed flaked 26 px over on the very next run — CLAUDE.md S5: measure the noise floor before trusting a rung). ofm_* stayed null: UNMEASURABLE on this runner — the pair blew a 300s per-test budget end-to-end (arm undetermined; the twin arm alone needed >35s pre-flip, and the chain arm cannot converge while the VT terminals are native-bodied), so the entries wait for either the terminal port or a faster runner.
